anti_bullshit_questions: Is that also the component making the claim?
Does the evidence prove the exact claim, or merely something adjacent?
Is the number measured, calculated, estimated, inferred, declared, or simulated?
Did the work occur, or was an object created saying the work occurred?
Is this functionality implemented, wired, exercised, observed, verified, and independently verified?
Could the same evidence support the opposite conclusion?

properties.name: Immutable intent
properties.testable_as: Hash original request. Any mutation without explicit correction record = fail.

properties.name: Exact Page 0 identity
properties.testable_as: All seats/matches carry same page0_hash. One altered child must hard-fail.

properties.name: Authority separation
properties.testable_as: No generated inference appears in owner-truth store without explicit promotion.

properties.name: Explicit provenance
properties.testable_as: Every material claim has source field. Missing source = fail.

properties.name: Correction precedence
properties.testable_as: Newer explicit correction overrides earlier interpretation in replay.

properties.name: Non-democratic truth
properties.testable_as: Majority vote cannot override evidence-backed minority finding.

properties.name: Non-recursive authority
properties.testable_as: Child findings cannot appear as parent authority source.

properties.name: Non-self-certification
properties.testable_as: Claimant component ID != verifier component ID for every verified claim.

properties.name: Claim/evidence separation
properties.testable_as: Count claims and evidence artifacts independently. They must not be conflated.

properties.name: Non-claim discipline
properties.testable_as: System maintains explicit list of what has NOT been established.

properties.name: Authority conservation
properties.testable_as: Authority level of output <= authority level of inputs.

properties.name: Intent traceability
properties.testable_as: Every requirement traces backward to Page 0 obligation.

properties.name: No semantic laundering
properties.testable_as: Generated text relabeled as explicit without owner action = fail.

properties.name: No success-by-completion
properties.testable_as: Pipeline completion alone cannot set status to verified.

properties.name: Productive diversity
properties.testable_as: Same Page 0 + different dimensions produces materially different evidence paths.

properties.name: Purpose specialization
properties.testable_as: Changing seat purpose changes investigative behavior measurably.

properties.name: Hypothesis diversity
properties.testable_as: Multiple causal explanations survive to testing phase.

properties.name: Method diversity
properties.testable_as: Same question attacked by >=2 different methods.

properties.name: Adversarial investigation
properties.testable_as: At least one seat actively attempts to falsify leading hypothesis.

properties.name: Minority preservation
properties.testable_as: Unpopular but evidence-backed findings survive to final round.

properties.name: Negative investigation
properties.testable_as: At least one investigation searches for reasons approach should NOT work.

properties.name: Counterexample search
properties.testable_as: For each major claim, at least one counterexample attempt logged.

properties.name: Boundary-case investigation
properties.testable_as: Edge cases explicitly tested, not just happy path.

properties.name: Failure-mode exploration
properties.testable_as: Failure modes enumerated and at least one tested.

properties.name: Alternative architecture search
properties.testable_as: At least one fundamentally different approach considered.

properties.name: Radical-solution search
properties.testable_as: Most ambitious approach identified and assessed.

properties.name: Opportunity discovery
properties.testable_as: At least one finding beyond obvious Page 0 interpretation.

properties.name: Unknown discovery
properties.testable_as: Investigation produces at least one new question.

properties.name: Parent-conditioned investigation
properties.testable_as: Child focus derived from parent findings, not random.

properties.name: Adaptive breadth
properties.testable_as: Unresolved areas receive proportionally more exploration.

properties.name: Novelty detection
properties.testable_as: New information distinguished from paraphrase (content hash).

properties.name: Evidence provenance
properties.testable_as: Every evidence item has source, method, timestamp.

properties.name: Evidence addressability
properties.testable_as: Every evidence item has stable ID.

properties.name: Evidence immutability after sealing
properties.testable_as: Sealed evidence hash unchanged on re-read.

properties.name: Evidence correction without deleting history
properties.testable_as: Correction creates new version, old retained.

properties.name: Corroboration tracking
properties.testable_as: Corroboration count tracked per evidence item.

properties.name: Independent corroboration distinguished from duplication
properties.testable_as: Same method + same result = duplicate. Different method = corroboration.

properties.name: Contradiction detection
properties.testable_as: Contradicting evidence flagged, not silently dropped.

properties.name: Evidence quality scoring
properties.testable_as: Quality score computed per defined formula.

properties.name: Evidence relevance scoring
properties.testable_as: Relevance to Page 0 scored per defined formula.

properties.name: Page 0 alignment scoring
properties.testable_as: Each evidence item mapped to Page 0 obligation(s).

properties.name: Method provenance
properties.testable_as: Investigation method recorded per evidence item.

properties.name: Evidence lineage through inheritance
properties.testable_as: Inherited evidence traces to origin seat.

properties.name: Evidence expiry/staleness semantics
properties.testable_as: Stale evidence flagged when context changes.

properties.name: Falsification evidence preservation
properties.testable_as: Killed hypotheses retained with kill reason.

properties.name: No evidence by comment
properties.testable_as: Code comment claiming behavior = not evidence.

properties.name: No evidence by receipt existence alone
properties.testable_as: Receipt proves transition, not claim content.

properties.name: Durable evidence artifacts
properties.testable_as: Evidence persists beyond run in addressable store.

properties.name: Every important hypothesis has kill condition
properties.testable_as: Each hypothesis paired with observable discriminator.

properties.name: Leading-hypothesis attack
properties.testable_as: Leading hypothesis subjected to dedicated falsification attempt.

properties.name: Controlled failure injection
properties.testable_as: System behavior under injected failure observed.

properties.name: Alternative explanation testing
properties.testable_as: At least one alternative explanation tested per major finding.

properties.name: Pair-order invariance testing
properties.testable_as: Shuffled tournament order produces same non-tied outcomes.

properties.name: Metrics outage testing
properties.testable_as: Metrics outage does not fail investigation.

properties.name: Tournament tie testing
properties.testable_as: Tie produces co-equal standing, not positional winner.

properties.name: Bad inheritance testing
properties.testable_as: Defective loser evidence rejected with reason.

properties.name: Runtime/source disagreement testing
properties.testable_as: Disagreement routes to investigation, not silent.

properties.name: Pulse-overclaim testing
properties.testable_as: Inflated Pulse claim caught by verification.

properties.name: Recursive decomposition
properties.testable_as: Parent task decomposed into child investigations.

properties.name: Parent-shaped descendants
properties.testable_as: Child focus derived from parent findings.

properties.name: Information-gain recursion
properties.testable_as: Deeper recursion requires expected information gain.

properties.name: Recursive Blueprint revision
properties.testable_as: Child results produce parent Blueprint revision.

properties.name: Recursive verification
properties.testable_as: Verification applies at each recursion level.

properties.name: Recursive failure routing
properties.testable_as: Failures route to appropriate recursion level.

properties.name: Recursive optimization
properties.testable_as: Each level can optimize its approach.

properties.name: No recursive amplification of unsupported assumptions
properties.testable_as: Unsupported claims do not gain authority through recursion.

properties.name: No recursive amplification of arbitrary champions
Isolated seat reasoning
properties.testable_as: Seat conclusions not contaminated by others.

properties.name: Controlled cross-seat communication
properties.testable_as: Inter-seat communication via defined channels only.

properties.name: Corroboration without duplicated cost where possible
properties.testable_as: Share results when methods are equivalent.

properties.name: Idempotent writes
properties.testable_as: Repeat writes have same effect as single.

properties.name: Method identity
properties.testable_as: Methods have stable identity for dedup.

properties.name: Shared knowledge without shared authority
properties.testable_as: Share information aggressively. Share authority reluctantly.

properties.name: Shared observation without shared conclusions
properties.testable_as: Same data can support different conclusions.

properties.name: Failure containment
properties.testable_as: One seat failure does not crash expedition.

properties.name: Run-local state
properties.testable_as: Per-run state isolated from other runs.

properties.name: No cross-run contamination
properties.testable_as: Run N cannot read Run N-1 state.

properties.name: One broken seat does not erase expedition
One corrupt ledger does not invalidate unrelated ledgers
Expensive reasoning earned by information need
Search only when evidence need warrants
Do not reuse stale or mismatched work
Cache by semantic identity
properties.testable_as: Cache key captures meaning, not just bytes.

properties.name: Measure avoided work separately from hypothetical savings
Value-of-information allocation
properties.testable_as: Spend proportional to expected information value.

properties.name: Stop spending when discrimination no longer improving
Evidence-quality selection
properties.testable_as: Winner chosen by evidence quality, not count.

properties.name: No positional selection masquerading as evidence
Operational representative distinguished from epistemic winner
No intelligence death merely because candidate loses
No defect survival merely because candidate wins
Page 0 compatibility checks
properties.testable_as: Inherited items must align with Page 0.

properties.name: No loser-takes-revenge defect smuggling
properties.testable_as: Loser defects do not sneak in.

properties.name: Obligation verification
properties.testable_as: Each obligation has evidence or is unresolved.

properties.name: What is highest defensible completion state?
Receipt is evidence of specific transition
Receipt cannot imply evidence outside scope
Source plausibility is not runtime evidence
No silent black-screen class of failure
Pulse reads evidence rather than claims
Highest proven state rather than highest claimed
Optimization cannot rewrite evaluation after seeing results
Performance improvement cannot weaken truth guarantees
Efficiency cannot silently reduce investigation quality
Optimization stops when evidence does not support further change

core_invariant: NO CLAIM MAY HAVE A HIGHER STATUS THAN ITS STRONGEST INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE.
key_principles: Share information aggressively. Share authority reluctantly.
These are candidate requirements, not automatic truth.
Each must become testable before entering a Blueprint.
Keep destroying unsupported claims until what remains is hard to bullshit.
